cases.title: Fix off-by-one inclusive range bug
cases.prompt: Fix the bug in src/calc.py: sum_range(a, b) must return the sum of all integers from a to b inclusive. Do not modify the tests. Run the test suite and make sure it passes.

cases.title: Rename a constant across a small package
cases.prompt: Rename the constant MAX_RETRIES to RETRY_LIMIT everywhere in the src package (config.py, client.py, worker.py, __init__.py) while keeping behavior identical. Do not modify the tests. Run the tests and make sure they pass.

cases.title: Add a regression test for a fixed empty-input bug
cases.prompt: src/report.py already contains the fix for the empty-input crash (empty list returns 0.0). Do not change src/report.py. Add a new regression test under tests/ proving that average([]) returns 0.0. The new test must pass on the current source and would fail on the old buggy behavior. Run the tests.

cases.title: RTL correction for a Hebrew cart UI
cases.prompt: The cart UI contains Hebrew text but renders LTR. Make the document RTL (lang=he, dir=rtl) and make .cart use direction: rtl, right text alignment and a direction-agnostic inline-start margin instead of left-only rules. Prices (.price) must stay LTR-safe with bidi isolation. Edit index.html and styles.css only.
